sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
| If you get your DSPT decoded a fourth time after finishing this questline, there is no way to get it encoded again! |

Make Amends - Software is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I understand if you and Lightkeeper have disagreements, but solving them with violence is not the answer. It taints our entire ecosystem. Okay, listen, I'm running out of software from the corporate flash drives that I use to flash transponders for Lightkeeper. Help me with these flash drives, and I'll try to change Lightkeeper's mind about you."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the third time.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over 15 found in raid Secure Flash drives

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
"Great, thank you. I'll take it from here."
